title: NBCP magnetocaloric model risk and quantum spectral flow
description: Reproducible public-data analysis of how long-range dipolar coupling, bond-dependent exchange, and interlayer exchange affect sub-kelvin magnetic-refrigeration operating decisions in Na2BaCo(PO4)2. The release includes classical finite-size and thermodynamic-limit calculations, engineering decision maps, ideal N=6/9/12 quantum-algorithm validation, and a scoped IBM Open Plan hardware pilot. No quantum advantage is claimed.
